name: zones_t13_examine_boundaries
description: Conformance test 13 (ExamineBoundaries, §7.3). Region 3 × 3 at x 10..12, z 10..12 with SetOptions(0, 1, 0) (placeStreets, so C starts at 0). Roads (network kind 0, flag bit 0) on (10..12, 9) -> side 0 matches ROAD_ONE_WAY (0x401): C[0] = max(C,1), S[0] += 100 per cell = 300. Streets (kind 3, bit 3) on (13, 10..12) -> side 1 matches STREET_DIRT (0x808): C[1] = 1, S[1] += 30 per cell = 90. Sides 2 and 3 see nothing, so each of their three cells takes the final rule (C = 0 -> S += 1) = 3 each. S = {300, 90, 3, 3}, C = {1, 1, 0, 0}. D = argmax S = 0; Q = for D in {0,2}: S[1] <= S[3] ? 3 : 1 -> 90 > 3 -> Q = 1; flag = 1 (zone 4 is not 1 or 2, so no swap). The same region with zone 1: placeStreets, zone 1 and a region wider and deeper than 2 -> flag = 0 and D <-> Q swap -> D = 1, Q = 0, flag = 0. The same with zone 4 and alternateOrientation: flag := not flag = 0 and D <-> Q swap -> D = 1, Q = 0, flag = 0.
